description: Land Acquisition - Deddugoda, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land to be acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants, along with procedures for compensation claims. This falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
